picc-vic.name: Picc-Vic tunnel
picc-vic.description: SELNEC PTE's 1971 plan for an underground rail link under the city centre between Piccadilly and Victoria, joining the Bury line to the lines south of Piccadilly through five stations; the government refused the grant in 1973 and the scheme was abandoned in 1977.

bee-network-2040.name: Bee Network 2040
bee-network-2040.description: The Metrolink and tram-train extensions of Greater Manchester's Transport Strategy 2040 and its delivery plans, promoted by TfGM and the Combined Authority: East Didsbury to Stockport (a business case going to the government in 2026), the Wythenshawe airport loop, Middleton, Stalybridge, Port Salford and Salford Crescent, and tram-trains onto rail lines to Heywood and Bury (given £5.7m for planning in 2025), Ashton via Denton, Hazel Grove, Wilmslow and Hale. None is funded for construction.
